trace.method: Separate 5s CDP trace per same 10-enemy scene; trace overhead excluded from performance claims; duration aggregates can overlap threads and are not GPU completion timing.

targetedAB.method: 10s after 2s warmup per paired legacy/skill encounter, immortal player, durable 100000HP enemies to hold entity counts, virtual Xbox primary edge every 700ms aimed away from enemies. Injection-to-observed-skill-start latency measured separately from HUD request-to-start metric. No native hardware latency claim. CPU metrics are rolling p95; ability metric includes combat. Effects count is concurrent statuses and projectiles, not cumulative events.
